Lifestyles

The travel lifestyle and how our hideaways are curated to your taste…

Hotlist

Our Hot List hideaways are homes created by owners who are passionate travellers. They are delightful, every single one of them, with wonderful owners who have chosen to share their private havens with us. View More

Beach

Escape to the seaside with Perfect Hideaways’ handpicked luxury beach accommodations. From stylish villas to cozy bungalows, enjoy comfort, privacy, and exceptional service at top coastal destinations. View More

Winelands

Discover our selection of luxury accommodation offerings in the breathtaking Cape Winelands of South Africa. This picturesque region, with its rolling vineyards and majestic mountain ranges. View More

City living

Discover vibrant city life with Perfect Hideaways’ luxury accommodations. From chic apartments to contemporary villas, enjoy comfort, style, and easy access to cultural landmarks, attractions, and bustling city streets. View More

Country living

Escape to the countryside with Perfect Hideaways. Enjoy charming cottages, luxurious farmhouses, and serene landscapes, offering the perfect blend of comfort, nature, and tranquility away from the everyday hustle. View More

Dog friendly

Discover our dog-friendly hideaways, where your furry friend is treated like family. Enjoy scenic walks, nature trails, and memorable stays in properties that cater to both you and your pet. View More

Just for two

Escape to an intimate retreat with our Just for Two hideaways. From secluded cottages to luxurious villas, these handpicked escapes offer the perfect setting for romance and relaxation. View More

Family

Create lasting memories with our family-friendly hideaways. From spacious villas to charming cottages, enjoy quality time together with private pools, nearby attractions, and a welcoming retreat for all ages. View More

Watersports

Discover the perfect blend of thrilling water sports and luxury accommodations. Our handpicked properties offer access to top kitesurfing, SUPing, and surfing spots, plus stylish, relaxing retreats. View More

Safari

Pack the khakis, the juicy novels, the camera, and the cossies: our safari hideaways provide the rest. Embark on the perfect safari with our collection of Big Five accommodation, bush hideaways, and luxurious safari lodges. Surrounded by captivating landscapes and abundant wildlife, these exclusive Big 5 safari lodges offer the best safari in Africa for couples and adventure seekers alike.

Escapes for fellow escapists

The Perfect Hideaways team travels far and wide to find extraordinary holiday escapes for fellow escapists. Our curated portfolio of soulful farms, cottages, lodges, villas and boutique hotels each hold a unique character, beauty and charm. Let us transport you to a place that appeals to your every sense!

South Africa

Revered as one of the most captivating countries to venture to, we’re patriotic about our South African portfolio. From dreamy seaside escapes to rustic, off-the-grid cottages in the most sought-after destinations across the country. View More

Italy

Time stands still in Tuscany, races in Rome and gently glides with the pulse of the people in Portofino. We’ve collated a very Italian catalogue of stylishly beautiful properties in some of the most stunning locations across the reputable boot of Europe. View More

Spain

Vamos a España! For the tapas, the sangria, the ritual of siesta and of course the Mediterranean sun. From 13th Century Farmhouses to rustic haciendas, we have tailored a fine selection of hideaways in some of the most charming locations. View More

Greece

We love a Greek excursion. Nothing says blue like the warm waters of the Aegean, Ionian and Mediterranean Seas, that engulf Greece’s coastline. Embark on a unique journey with us, from the picturesque islands, to the historical cities. View More

Kenya

A country that holds the romance of Africa in the palm of its hands and the helm of our hearts, we love a Kenyan adventure. Experience the wonder of Kenya – sensational safari lodges to bona fide beachfront villas. View More

France

A place on the map that needs little to no introduction, where we venture to for the love of hot, buttery bakes and all things beautiful, Bienvenue en France. We’ve selected the crème de la crème in some of the most picturesque villages across France. View More

Namibia

The remote, untamed wilderness of the Skeleton Coast, the dunes and the magic of the Namib desert await the intrepid traveller’s insatiable appetite for adventure. Exclusive safari lodges to secluded mountain camps. View More

Sweden

Stay in ancient castles and designer gems in the land of ABBA, Vikings and long summer nights. Explore pretty archipelagos, rolling countryside and more. View More

Mozambique

Cue the coconut palms, the coral reefs, the squeaky white sands and warm, tropical waters of the Indian Ocean. Experience the ultimate treasure trove of exclusive properties, in some of the most beautiful locations in Mozambique. View More

Introducing Italy

Discover Italy through our eyes: our curated collection of whimsical castles, elegant palazzos, contemporary casas and restored masserias or farmhouses.

South Africa

Revered as one of the most captivating countries to explore, we’re passionate about our South African portfolio. Design your ideal South African holiday or weekend escape with Perfect Hideaways’ luxury accommodation selection. From dreamy seaside escapes to rambling farms or rustic off-the-grid cottages, we offer a delectable smorgasbord of unique and beautiful properties in the most sought-after destinations across the country.

Cape Town

Voted time and again as one of the best places in the world to visit, we marvel at the myriad attributes this magnificent city so generously displays. View More

West Coast

Our West Coast hamlets offer an immersive experience. Choose from cosy fisherman’s cottages to multigenerational family beach houses… some delightfully simple, others deceptively luxurious. View More

Garden Route

With its lush forests, mountains, pretty coastal roads and some of the most beautiful beaches in the world, the Garden Route exceeds all our expectations when it comes to taking the scenic route. View More

Karoo

Discover the Karoo’s rugged beauty and placid charm with our handpicked hideaways. From restored farmhouses to luxurious lodges, each one a unique and authentic experience. View More

Cape Winelands

This picturesque region, with its rolling vineyards and majestic mountain ranges, offers a delightful blend of nature, culture and indulgence. View More

Overberg

Immerse yourself in the natural beauty of this coastal area, featuring fynbos-clad mountains, pristine beaches and charming towns. View More

Discover Kenya

Authentic and romantic, Kenya awaits! Experience the magic of Lamu island, with its narrow streets and ancient forts an historic blend of Arab, Persian and African influences. Traditional dhows sail the Indian Ocean breezes, donkeys clip clop through the market and beach days are languid, its Indian Ocean waters balmy. Combined with Kenya’s safari experiences, this is the ultimate combination, offering a dream ending to an unforgettable trip to Africa.

Discover the magic of Mauritius with Perfect Hideaways’ collection of handpicked luxury accommodation offerings. From private villas to beachfront bungalows, we have consciously curated a selection of unique and beautiful properties in some of the most breathtaking locations on the island.

An island life of unparalleled bliss! Sharing our favourite tropical island escapes where luxury knows no bounds.

The perfect story

Helen Untiedt, curator and co-founder of Perfect Hideaways, has spent the past 20 years travelling together with her husband David through the back roads, coastlines and bushveld of southern Africa, discovering dream destinations tucked away in beautiful locations. Each one reveals its unique attributes, many outlandish and unexpected, yet they are always effortlessly comfortable.

Helen has handpicked every hideaway for its ‘sense of soul’. Quintessentially South African, they share an unspoken history with you, that’s as pacifying as it is inspiring. Enticing you to return time and again, experiencing a world of curiosity and serenity.
